assertions.title: Graceful shutdown (Python)

steps.action: Run the graceful-shutdown pytest surface with verbose test names.
steps.expected: The suite proves state persistence, signal handling, cleanup ordering, and valid state timestamps/fields.
steps.observed: 19/19 tests passed in 0.78s. Named passing tests included test_shutdown_persists_state, test_shutdown_state_fields_valid, test_shutdown_cleanup_runs_lifo, test_stop_callbacks_fire_before_cleanup, test_signal_handler_raises_system_exit, test_signal_handler_persists_state, test_state_timestamp_is_recent, and test_save_state_failure_does_not_prevent_cleanup.

observations: The passing tests cover persisted snapshot contents (`profile`, `action`, `progress`, `timestamp`), recent timestamp validation, LIFO cleanup ordering, stop-callback-before-cleanup ordering, signal-driven `SystemExit(0)`, idempotent shutdown, and entrypoint integration hooks.
The CLI surface emitted non-fatal post-suite logging errors from `python.core.shutdown._run_shutdown` after the suite had already passed.

assertions.title: Python circuit breaker functional

steps.action: Run the circuit-breaker pytest surface with verbose test names.
steps.expected: The suite proves open, half-open, and closed transitions plus fail-fast behavior.
steps.observed: 26/26 tests passed in 3.52s. Named passing tests included test_failures_at_threshold_open_circuit, test_open_circuit_raises_on_check, test_half_open_after_recovery_timeout, test_half_open_blocks_second_caller, test_probe_success_closes_circuit, test_probe_failure_reopens_circuit, test_probe_failure_reopen_blocks_next_call, test_full_lifecycle, test_full_lifecycle_with_probe_failure, and test_circuit_breaker_trips_after_repeated_failures.

observations: The unit-level state-machine tests prove closed → open → half-open → closed/open transitions.
The ResilientHttpClient integration tests prove fail-fast behavior in open state, recovery probe success, probe-failure re-open, and retryable 5xx/429 handling around the circuit breaker.

assertions.title: Sentry gracefully degrades when DSN absent (Python layer only)
assertions.coverageScope: Python layer only; this flow does not validate frontend or server startup without DSNs.

steps.expected: The helper should return false/no-op without crashing.
steps.observed: `initial_env_before_unset` and `env_after_unset_before_init` were null; `first_init_result` and `second_init_result` were both false; `_initialized` stayed false.

steps.action: Import lightweight runner entrypoint modules without running automation.
steps.expected: Imports should succeed without crashing and expose their `main` entrypoints.
steps.observed: Both `python.runners.workflow.entrypoint` and `python.runners.multi_account.entrypoint` imported successfully and exposed `main`.

steps.action: Unset `SENTRY_DSN_PYTHON` again after runner imports and call `init_sentry()` once more.
steps.expected: The helper should still return false/no-op.
steps.observed: Runner imports repopulated `SENTRY_DSN_PYTHON` via `.env`, but after unsetting it again `third_init_after_runner_imports_result` was false.

observations: This validates only the Python helper/no-op path plus safe entrypoint imports; it is not full end-to-end DSN-absent startup coverage for all three platforms.

Runner entrypoint imports trigger `.env` hydration through `python.core.config`, which can repopulate `SENTRY_DSN_PYTHON` even after an in-process unset; the direct helper guard remained no-op when the variable was unset before each call.

frictions.description: The `tuistory` CLI was not installed in this Windows Exec environment (`tuistory --version` was not recognized), so CLI evidence was captured as saved terminal transcript files instead of tuistory snapshots.
frictions.resolution: Used PowerShell `Tee-Object` to persist exact command output under the mission evidence directory.

frictions.description: After `python/tests/test_graceful_shutdown.py` finished with 19 passing tests, Python 3.14 emitted repeated non-fatal logging errors (`ValueError: I/O operation on closed file`) from `python.core.shutdown._run_shutdown` during interpreter teardown.
frictions.resolution: Recorded only; no source changes were allowed in this validation flow.

frictions.description: Importing runner entrypoints hydrates `.env` through `python.core.config`, which repopulated `SENTRY_DSN_PYTHON` after the smoke script had unset it.
frictions.resolution: Unset `SENTRY_DSN_PYTHON` again after the imports and reran `init_sentry()`; it still returned false/no-op.

summary: Validated 3 assigned items through the Python CLI surface: VAL-REL-002 passed via 19/19 graceful-shutdown tests, VAL-REL-004 passed via 26/26 circuit-breaker tests, and VAL-FOUND-009 passed for Python-layer no-op Sentry initialization only (explicitly limited to Python coverage).
